about: Measured from the vanilla prefabs by lab/extract_models.py (render bounds of the LOD0 meshes; the solid colliders, meaning not triggers and on a layer the player collides with, as oriented boxes c/s/q, spheres and capsules; snap points; all in the piece's own frame, metres) and a low-poly proxy per piece: boxes (c center, s size, q rotation) and prisms (p outline in the part's x-y plane, d depth along its z), each with a color sampled from the game texture (col) and a material class (m), packed (lib/mesh.js unpack: grouped by color, material and rotation, whole millimeters); k: the coarse proxy, for the quick overlap pre-test, or the only one; fine: 1 when data/piece-fine.json has its parts fitted to within 2 cm of the mesh (4 mm for the item stands; err gives the measure in mm). kind: lib/pieces.js role. pass: no solid collider, a player walks through it. Built by lab/build_models.js.
